bounded_adapter.placement_reason: place one registered tree across the fixed SCAN start-to-goal corridor
bounded_adapter.selection_reason: retain the upstream terrain algorithm and source visual assets without invoking its nondeterministic full population generator or instantiating thousands of independent grass prims
bounded_adapter.terrain_seed_injection: FractalNoise(seed=14) plus numpy seed 14 for BasicMicrorelief; forest_gen v0.3.8 otherwise constructs unseeded RandomState and random.Random(None) instances

robot_asset.composition_boundary: Only the V12 robot spawn asset and fixed-joint preservation are changed; checkpoint, policy loader, observations, actions, actuators, default pose, command schedule, and controller remain V12.

sensor.obstacle_return_classification: finite hit inside a declared visible physics-and-sensor proxy bound

planner_floor_filter.reason: replaced by the geometry-only local terrain filter in V5

sensor.self_occlusion_treatment: Ray-cast against moving rig geometry; discard a blocking self hit inside the declared minimum range without allowing the ray to pass through to environment geometry.
